    term2 = FractionOps.from_parts(11, 18)

    correct_answer_dict = {
        "numerator": numerator,
        "denominator": denominator,
        "canonical_latex": latex_str
    }

        "correct_answer": correct_answer_dict,
        "oracle_payload": frozen_params
    }
